title: CastillosBurstVEP40
description: EEG recordings from 12 healthy participants performing an offline 4-class code-modulated visual evoked potential (c-VEP) reactive BCI task. The study introduces 'Burst c-VEP', which uses short bursts of aperiodic flashes at 2-4 Hz. It compares burst and m-sequence codes at 100% and 40% amplitude depth, and evaluates CNN-based bitwise decoding, calibration time and visual comfort. This BIDS derivative holds the 40% amplitude burst condition.
methods_description: 32-channel EEG was recorded at 500 Hz with a BrainProducts LiveAmp and active Acticap electrodes (reference FCz, ground FPz). Participants attended to cued targets in a factorial design of code type (burst or m-sequence) by amplitude depth (100% or 40%). Each participant completed 15 blocks of 4 trials per condition, with a 2.2 s stimulation period per trial. Decoding used an improved EEG2Code CNN architecture.
